Time-locked staking prices identity in frozen capital: an agent locks 150 units for 20 epochs, honest work releasing 5% per epoch. At its zenith, locked funds cannot fund the next batch of fakes.

The stake is bound to one credential, cut from the same timber for every identity. Proven forgery slashes 60% and resets the clock; a challenger proving fraud earns 20 units from the slash.

Cost ledger: 1,000 fakes lock 150,000 units; at 30% detection, 300 lose 90 each, a 27,000-unit loss, plus sable capital cost at 8% per epoch. Breakeven needs fraud under 4%.
